text: SBI is giving Rs 5,000 cashback to every customer today. Forward this message to 10 people to claim your reward.
You must enter your UPI PIN to receive the refund credited to your account.
note: A PIN is never needed to receive money.

text: The central government is distributing free laptops to all students under a new scheme.
The Rs 2,000 note contains a GPS nano chip that lets the government track it.
Drinking hot water every 15 minutes kills the coronavirus before it reaches the lungs.
Cow urine cures cancer and doctors are hiding the evidence.
Polio drops given at government camps cause infertility in children.
note: Health rumour with a real vaccination-programme cost.

text: COVID-19 vaccines contain a microchip that tracks the person who received it.

सरकार सभी छात्रों को मुफ्त लैपटॉप दे रही है, लिंक पर रजिस्टर करें।
गोमूत्र कैंसर ठीक करता है और डॉक्टर इसे छिपा रहे हैं।

SBI हर ग्राहक को 5,000 रुपये कैशबैक दे रहा है, यह संदेश 10 लोगों को भेजें।

Sarkar ne sabhi students ko free laptop dene ka announcement kiya hai.
SBI har grahak ko 5000 rupaye cashback de raha hai, ye message 10 logon ko forward karo.
Sarkari camp mein di jane wali polio drops se bachchon mein bandhyapan hota hai.
2000 ke note mein GPS chip lagi hai, sarkar sab track kar rahi hai.
The Reserve Bank of India reduced the repo rate by 25 basis points at its monetary policy meeting.
note: The one corpus entry rated true. A checker that cannot say true is a censor.

text: The Delhi Metro has raised fares by 40 percent from next Monday.

note: Hinglish AND unindexed: must not be dragged onto a nearby seed entry.

text: नई दिल्ली में कल से सभी स्कूल दो हफ्ते के लिए बंद कर दिए गए हैं।

note: Regression guard: transliteration pushed this to 0.459 against the salt-shortage rumour. See DECISIONS.md O1.

text: Bhai kal movie dekhne chalein kya, tickets book kar loon?

text: Boiling water before drinking it reduces the risk of waterborne disease.
note: Adjacent to the hot-water rumour and actually sound. A false here is the worst failure the system can produce.

text: COVID-19 vaccines were tested in clinical trials before being approved.
